description: Create a new application from a GitHub repository using S2I build and expose it with an edge-terminated route

appName.description: Name for the application (if not specified, derives from repo name)

contextDir.description: Context directory within the Git repository

createNamespace.description: Create namespace if it does not exist

exposeRoute.description: Create an edge-terminated route to expose the application

gitRef.description: Git reference (branch, tag, or commit) to build from (default: main/master)

gitRepo.description: GitHub repository URL for the source code

routeHostname.description: Custom hostname for the route (if not specified, uses default)

name: oc_new_app
